content.title: Zeekr reports 44,843 vehicles delivered in August
content.summary: Zeekr (ZK) Group announced its delivery results for August. In August, Zeekr Group delivered a total of 44,843 vehicles across its Zeekr and Lynk & Co brands, reflecting increases of 10.6% year-over-year and 1.5% compared to the previous month. Specifically, the Zeekr brand delivered 17,626 vehicles, while Lynk & Co delivered 27,217 vehicles.
